name: Blueway RV Park
note: Cove Communities park of about 375 RV sites around a stormwater pond, sold by the night, week, season and year, with a handful of cottages and rental trailers; nightly sites sell out in the winter. The booking engine tags it 55+ while the operator's page calls it an all-age RV park. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator page (covecommunities.com, read 2026-10-21): 375 full-hookup RV sites rented 'daily, weekly, or for the season', back-in sites 'ideal for RVs up to 29 feet'; Cove booking engine read 2026-10-21 sells 2-night stays (Tue 10/27/2026 and Tue 2/9/2027) to a 23-ft Class C with no application, five RV site types; Cove's home-sales feed lists no homes for sale at Blueway and the park map shows ~15 M-lots against ~300 numbered RV sites -> real transient RV park, not a home community; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery read 2026-10-21 (900 m and 220 m frames, both rendered) at 26.4569,-81.8319: RV pads line the north and south shores of the park's own ~170x60 m stormwater pond a few metres from the water across open lawn, no road or treeline between; the operator's engine sells 'Lake Full Hookup RV' sites and 'Lake ... Premium' sites 'located on the water' with a wooden deck -> pond (same call as Sun Retreats Estero Bay 14881, 0.8 km away)
fees_source: https://bookings.covecommunities.com/AvailabilityPark.aspx?resparkid=14784 read 2026-10-21, 2 adults, Motor Class C 23 ft, cheapest type 'Full Hookup RV' (back-in): $42/night avg for Tue 10/27/2026 x2 nights (checkout page: 2 nights $84.00, taxes $0.00, no other fees) and $121/night for Tue 2/9/2027 x2 nights (peak; all other types sold out); before tax
booking_source: https://bookings.covecommunities.com/AvailabilityPark.aspx?resparkid=14784 read 2026-10-21: after picking a Tuesday arrival the depart calendar greys out the next day and opens two nights later, both for 10/27/2026 and 2/9/2027
flags: Peak-winter weeknight base is $121/night (Feb 2027); off-season $42. Included only because the price gate is lifted.
Booking engine labels the park 55+; the operator page says 'All Age RV Park'. Recorded in the note, not a skip.
No seasonal vs nightly site count published, so long-stay test 4 passes by default; seasonal and annual sites are sold alongside nightly ones.
